selected_result: Behaviour of the LAPACK-style condition estimator on a parametrized tridiagonal family

bibliographic_source.title: Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed., Chapter 15: Condition Number Estimation, Problem 15.3

paper_locations.anchor: Problem 15.3: the family T_n(alpha) and the estimate produced by Algorithm 15.3

task_clarification: Let T_n(alpha) be the n x n symmetric tridiagonal family defined by the source, with t_ii = 2 for i = 1, t_ii = i for 2 <= i <= n-1, t_nn = -t_{n,n-1} + alpha, and the stated off-diagonal pattern.
For all alpha the family satisfies ||T_n(alpha) e_{n-1}||_1 = ||T_n(alpha)||_1.
For 0 <= alpha < 1, formalize that Algorithm 15.3 has x = e_{i-1} on iteration i for i = 2, ..., n and converges on iteration n.

Also formalize the stated contrast for Algorithm 15.4: it terminates after five iterations with y_5 = T_n(alpha)e_4, its intermediate estimate has ratio ||y_5||_1 / ||T_n(alpha)||_1 = (8-alpha)/(2*n-2-alpha), which tends to zero as n tends to infinity, while its extra estimate makes the final returned estimate lie within a factor 3 of the true norm for every alpha < 1.
scope_constraints: The matrix family is exactly the one defined in the problem statement.
Algorithm 15.3 is the estimator defined by the source.
Use 0 <= alpha < 1 for the iteration and convergence claims; retain the source's stated alpha < 1 range for the final factor-3 claim.
Represent the family and the estimator rather than assuming the conclusion.
All stated conclusions in Problem 15.3 are selected; proving only the Algorithm 15.3 subclaim is incomplete.
